jobs.title: SVP, Information Technology
jobs.description:
**We Create Products and Brands That People Trust to Clean, Sanitize, and Protect Their Homes and Pools**
When you join KIK Consumer Products, you’re joining a team that cares about the work we do and also about each other. We bring exceptional brands and products to consumers that help them protect the health and wellness of their families and the cleanliness of their homes and pools. We are committed to building a culture of performance driven by accountability, collaboration, and agility that enables timely fact\-based decision\-making and exceptional execution with unwavering ethics. As one of North America’s largest independent manufacturers of consumer products, KIK helps a large portfolio of brands and retailers bring their products to life. **Your Role at KIK**
The Senior Vice President of Information Technology will set and execute KIK's enterprise technology strategy, enabling business growth, manufacturing performance, operational excellence, and measurable value creation. This executive will lead IT operations, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, data and analytics, AI and automation, and technology supporting KIK's manufacturing network.

  

Partnering closely with executive leadership, the VP will translate business priorities into a practical multi\-year technology roadmap, modernize and simplify the technology environment, strengthen security and resilience, and build a high\-performing IT organization grounded in accountability, transparency, collaboration, and business partnership. **What You’ll Do*** Set and deliver a multi\-year enterprise technology and investment roadmap aligned with business and operational priorities
* Partner with executive and operational leaders to prioritize technology investments and translate them into measurable business outcomes
* Lead reliable, secure technology across corporate offices, manufacturing sites, warehouses, and distribution centers
* Advance IT/OT integration, plant connectivity, automation, analytics, and digital manufacturing capabilities
* Lead ERP, enterprise applications, data, architecture, integrations, and modernization initiatives, including SAP/S/4HANA where applicable
* Own cybersecurity, technology risk, disaster recovery, and business continuity across IT and OT environments

* Lead technology governance, budgeting, vendor management, sourcing decisions, and value realization
* Build and develop a high\-performing IT organization and strategic partner network.
* Communicate technology priorities, performance, risks, and investment needs with executive leadership and the Board, as appropriate
* Support technology due diligence and integrations or separations for acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring as needed
* Develop, coach, and retain a high\-performing IT leadership team, building the capabilities, accountability, and succession needed to support the organization’s strategic objectives.
* Serve as a strategic business partner to executive and functional leaders, aligning technology priorities and investments with business goals, operational needs, and growth initiatives.
* Lead the evaluation, implementation, and scaling of AI\-enabled solutions that improve productivity, decision\-making, operational performance, and employee or customer experience.
* Partner cross\-functionally to identify high\-value AI use cases, establish appropriate governance and adoption plans, and lead change management efforts to ensure successful implementation.
* Partner with business and commercial leaders to co\-lead the development and execution of eCommerce capabilities, ensuring technology solutions support digital growth, customer experience, and evolving business needs

 **What You’ll Bring*** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred
* 15\+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility in a complex enterprise environment
* Experience leading technology in multi\-site manufacturing, industrial, consumer products, chemical, or similarly complex operations strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise IT strategies and multi\-year roadmaps tied to business and financial outcomes
* Significant ERP and enterprise applications experience; major ERP transformation, upgrade, or implementation experience strongly preferred; SAP/S/4HANA experience is highly relevant
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing technology and IT/OT environments, cybersecurity, infrastructure/cloud, data and analytics, AI/automation, and business continuity
* Experience managing significant budgets, vendors, sourcing models, and enterprise\-wide transformation in fast\-paced environments
* Executive\-level communication, critical thinking, analytical capability, and the ability to build trust and influence across all levels of the organization

 **What You Will Get**
KIK offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits including health, wellness, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. You can plan for your future with KIK's retirement savings options including employer match. KIK also recognizes the importance of continuing education and offers Education Assistance to our employees to encourage continued personal development and growth.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Nucleus Independent Living is an innovative and learning organization, focused on providing exceptional, culturally\-sensitive care to residents in the Mississauga Halton community to enable frail seniors and adults living with physical disabilities to live their best life independently, at home. Our highly committed staff embody our ICCARE values of Innovation, Compassion, Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence in the delivery of personalized care, where every person’s experience is exceptional, every time. We are committed to creating a safe environment where you feel heard, valued for the work you do, able to grow and learn, and make a difference to every person you touch.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, provide leadership, financial expertise, and sound management principles in planning, directing, and delivering core corporate finance services, with a particular emphasis on financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), while working as part of an innovative and committed senior leadership team. The role serves as a strategic business partner to the CFO, CEO, Senior Leadership Team and Board of Directors, leading the budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and performance reporting that inform resource allocation, funding decisions and the organization’s long\-term financial sustainability. The role also oversees information technology (through the organization’s External IT Service Provider), property management, and administrative services. As a health information custodian, this role is also responsible for the management of risks and business impacts of privacy laws and policies related to the collection, use, disclosure and retention of personal health information by all staff, volunteers, and vendors of the organization.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

Key Responsibilities:

* Oversee all Financial Operations, including Payroll \& Benefits Administration in a unionized environment.
* Provide interpretation and advice to all levels of management and staff on organizational business, financial issues, organizational budgetary issues and reporting of government funded services.
* Lead the annual operating budget process ($20M\+), including setting planning assumptions, partnering with program leaders to build departmental budgets, and presenting the budget for approval by the Board of Directors, in alignment with the Ministry of Health and Ontario Health’s Multi\-Service Sector Accountability Agreement (M\-SAA).
* Develop and maintain multi\-year financial plans and rolling forecasts, including scenario and sensitivity analysis, to support strategic decision\-making and long\-term financial sustainability.
* Build and maintain financial models to evaluate new programs, service expansions, funding proposals, capital investments and other business cases, providing clear, evidence\-based recommendations to the CFO, CEO and Board.
* Analyze program\-level costs, funding and service volumes (e.g., cost per unit of service) to identify trends, efficiency opportunities and financial risks, and recommend corrective actions to program leaders.
* Develop and report key performance indicators and management dashboards that connect financial results to operational and service outcomes.
* Lead the financial analysis supporting funding applications, in\-year forecast submissions and funding reallocation requests to Ontario Health and other funders.
* Lead the preparation of financial statements, variance analysis explaining key drivers, forecasts and other monthly, quarterly and annual financial and statistical reports and analysis to internal stakeholders and external stakeholders which include the MOH, Ontario Health Central and the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA), ensuring compliance with reporting requirements and funding agreements.
* Oversee the creation and implementation of sound internal controls that ensure general ledger integrity, accuracy and compliance of financial reporting and mechanisms for appropriate budget control.
* Oversee the external audit of financial statements including the preparation of various year end working papers.
* Lead and develop a team of two (2\) Financial Analysts, building the team’s capability in financial analysis, forecasting and decision\-support reporting.
* Develop and oversee back office support initiatives to other non\-profit/registered charity organizations.
* In conjunction with the Chief Financial Officer and Senior Leadership Team, work to design, develop, and implement strategic and operational plans, ensuring they are supported by sound financial plans, analysis and resource allocation.
* Oversee the Organization’s insurance requirements ensuring adequate coverage and that risk management processes are in place to protect the organization’s assets.
* Staff support to the Finance, Resource and Audit Committee as well as participation in other Board and Operational committees as required.
* Provide oversight of the organization’s information technology through Nucleus’s External IT Service Provider, including managing the service agreement and provider performance, the IT budget and IT\-related risks, and ensuring finance and reporting systems deliver accurate, timely information for decision\-making.
* Oversee the organization's physical infrastructure, including maintenance and upkeep of the facilities, lease negotiation, office allocation, building renovations or upgrades.
* Oversee all the activities related to the development, implementation, maintenance and adherence to the organization’s privacy policies and procedures. These policies cover the collection, use, disclosure and retention of personal health information in compliance with the Personal Health Information Protection Act (“PHIPA”).

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs the responsibilities of the position according to legislative and regulatory standards set out in Provincial Acts and consistent with the policies of Nucleus Indep

jobs.description:
Job title: Director, Financial Planning and Analysis


Reporting to: Chief Financial Officer


Years of experience: 10\+ years


Location: This role is based in Toronto and follows a hybrid work arrangement, with three days per week in the Toronto office and the remaining workdays remote.


Position type: Full\-time


Working conditions: Regular collaboration across global time zones and international travel up to 20% of working time, are required.


**About Raising The Village**

Raising The Village's mission is to build and strengthen pathways out of ultra\-poverty through an approach guided by data, designed with communities, and scaled by partnerships. We work with last\-mile communities to implement solutions that raise incomes, sustain impact, and chart sustainable pathways to possibility within 24 months. To date, we have supported more than two million people in Uganda, Rwanda, and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with support from our partners and our team in North America. Find out more about our programs and impact at www.raisingthevillage.org (http://www.raisingthevillage.org/).


**Position overview**


The Director, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A) will play a critical role in leading RTV's forward\-looking finance function and serving as a strategic partner to the CFO, executive leadership, country teams, and functional leaders. The Director will own enterprise planning, rolling forecasts, performance analysis, scenario modelling, and decision support, translating financial and operational data into clear choices, risks, and actions.


As one of three finance pillars reporting to the CFO, the Global FP\&A function provides a forward\-looking planning and performance perspective alongside Controllership and Accounting. The Director will lead this function and establish consistent planning disciplines, management reporting, and business\-partnering practices across the organization.


**Key responsibilities**


*Enterprise Planning, Forecasting \& Scenario Analysis*


* Own the annual consolidated budget, rolling forecast, multi\-year plan, and in\-year reforecasting cycles across countries, departments, programs, and funding sources.
* Develop integrated financial and operational planning models that connect program reach, cost per beneficiary, staffing, capital requirements, funding, and cash needs.
* Lead scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess growth options, funding gaps, foreign exchange exposure, cost pressures, and strategic trade\-offs.
* Maintain clear planning assumptions, version control, decision logs, and reconciliations to approved organizational targets.

*Performance Management \& Executive Insight*


* Own the budget and KPI performance\-management process, including setting review standards, monitoring results against approved targets, and driving accountability for corrective actions;
* Lead quarterly performance reviews at the executive and country levels.
* Translate results into concise commentary on drivers, variances, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain an enterprise performance framework that integrates financial and non\-financial indicators.
* Prepare CFO, executive leadership, Board, and Finance/Audit/Risk Committee materials with decision\-focused analysis and transparent supporting logic.

*Strategic Business Partnering*


* Act as the senior finance partner to organisational leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and improving the financial quality of decisions.
* Support business cases, program design, workforce planning, country expansion, investment decisions, and resource allocation.
* Partner with Programs, Partnerships, People, IT, Procurement, and country leadership to connect strategy, delivery plans, and financial capacity.
* Provide financial modelling and analysis for donor proposals, cost recovery, funding sustainability, and restricted versus unrestricted resource decisions.

*Cash, Funding \& Sustainability Planning*


* Lead forward\-looking liquidity and cash flow forecasting in partnership with Accounting and Controllership, with clear visibility over restricted and unrestricted cash and reserve requirements.
* Maintain funding\-gap and runway analysis, identifying timing, concentration, and affordability risks for leadership action.
* Ensure planning outputs reconcile to the general ledger, grant records, treasury forecasts, and approved budgets, while preserving appropriate separation between planning and accounting ownership.

*Data, Systems \& Process Improvement*


* Own the FP\&A reporting and analytics roadmap, including dashboards, planning models, data definitions, and management\-reporting standards.
* Advance the effective use of ERP (Sage Intacct/ Dynamics Business central are a plus), Power BI, Excel, and other planning or analytics tools; support finance\-system integration and ERP improvement initiatives.
* Improve forecast accuracy, cycle times, data quality, and self\-service reporting through standardization, automation, and clear controls.
* Establish a single source of truth for management reporting and ensure consistent treatment of currencies, allocations, beneficiaries, and program cost drivers.

*Team Leadership \& Capability Building*


* Lead, coach, and develop the East Africa FP\&A team, setting clear accountability, service standards, and development plans.
* Build FP\&A and financial literacy across budget owners through practical training, templates, guidance, and ongoing coaching.
* Promote a high\-performance culture grounded in collaboration, curiosity, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
* Create resilient processes with appropriate documentation, cross\-training, succession planning, and coverage for key activities.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Job Description:  

The **Regional Director, Data \& Artificial Intelligence** provides strategic and operational leadership for regional data, analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and data governance services within the Regional Digital Health portfolio. The role is responsible for advancing a regional Data and AI strategy that supports data\-driven decision making, responsible AI adoption, innovation, and improved clinical, operational, financial, research, and patient outcomes across Central Region North organizations.


Working collaboratively with hospital, research, and industry partners, the Director oversees the development of foundational data and AI capabilities, governance frameworks, and advanced analytics solutions while ensuring compliance with privacy, ethical, and regulatory requirements. The role also supports research innovation through secure and responsible use of data assets.


**Education \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in health informatics, Data Science, Information Management, Computer Science, Analytics, Business Administration, Health Administration, or related field.
* Masters or Doctoral degree considered an asset.
* Formal education or certification in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, Data Governance, or Digital Transformation considered an asset.


**Competencies:**


* Strategic leadership and systems thinking
* Healthcare analytics and performance measurement
* Data governance and information management
* Business intelligence and decision support
* Artificial intelligence and machine learning governance
* Data science and advanced analytics
* Data architecture and engineering principles
* Privacy, security, ethics, and regulatory compliance
* Healthcare research and innovation ecosystems
* Executive communication and influence
* Change leadership and stakeholder engagement
* Financial and business case development
* Partnership and relationship management
* Program and portfolio management
* Innovation leadership and value realization


**Responsibilities:**


* Provide strategic and operational leadership for regional Data, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Governance services.
* Lead the development and execution of Data and AI strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks, and investment plans that advance digital health transformation and improve organizational performance.
* Build, coach, and sustain high\-performing multidisciplinary teams while supporting workforce development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Oversee data governance, privacy, stewardship, quality, interoperability, security, ethical AI practices, and compliance with legislative, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
* Advance business intelligence, decision support, self\-service analytics, predictive analytics, modern data platforms, and scalable architecture to enable timely, accurate, and actionable insights.
* Guide the responsible evaluation, prioritization, implementation, monitoring, and adoption of AI solutions that support patient care, operational efficiency, workforce productivity, research, and healthcare system outcomes.
* Develop trusted partnerships with executives, clinicians, operational leaders, researchers, Ontario Health, academic institutions, vendors, and regional partners to align priorities and accelerate innovation.
* Represent RVH and the Central Region North LDG in regional, provincial, and national Data and AI forums, serving as executive sponsor and subject matter leader for regional initiatives.
* Reduce the cost and increase the maturity of Data and AI in the region through rationalization, standardization and centralization of resources, services and digital platforms.
* Lead and chair regional Data Governance \& Analytics and AI Governance committees, ensuring effective decision\-making, accountability, prioritization, risk management, and alignment with organizational and regional strategic objectives.
* Provide periodic reporting and recommendations to executive leadership teams, governance committees, and Boards regarding Data and AI strategy, performance, risks, compliance, investment priorities, and realized outcomes.


Exhibits the core values of Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre: Inspire Trust, Be Kind, Be Bold, Do Great Things, Team Up.

As a Practice Director \- Sales, you will be responsible for guiding business decisions related to Sales and Customer Service processes as part of our ERP transformation. You will play a key role in harmonizing business practices, optimizing processes, and supporting the adoption of solutions that drive organizational growth and efficiency.

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:*** Develop a comprehensive understanding of business activities, process architecture, and the future objectives of the functional area.
* Define guiding principles, priorities, and expected outcomes for Sales and Customer Service processes.
* Resolve conflicting needs across business units, teams, and processes while making clear and timely decisions.
* Validate major operational changes, deviations from standard processes, and proposed trade\-offs.
* Work closely with the Core Team Analyst to maintain a decision\-making pace aligned with project timelines.
* Mobilize managers, subject matter experts, and end users around agreed\-upon business directions.
* Champion decisions and support change management efforts through adoption.
* Ensure the selected solution supports both current operations and medium\- and long\-term business objectives.
* Participate in design workshops, decision reviews, and sessions requiring business arbitration.
* Review options, impacts, risks, and dependencies prepared by the Core Team.
* Consult stakeholders when required and make decisions within project timelines.
* Communicate business directions and explain the rationale behind decisions.
* Support critical Go\-Live activities and escalations impacting the functional area.
  

  

  

**You are the person we are looking for if you have:*** A university degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* The ability to distinguish between local preferences, business requirements, and regulatory or operational obligations.
* A strong understanding of integrated Order\-to\-Cash processes, including order management, pricing, fulfillment, invoicing, returns, and after\-sales service.
* A solid understanding of the interdependencies between Sales, Customer Service, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Operations.
* The ability to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and assess their compatibility with standard ERP capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills in a complex environment with competing priorities.
* A demonstrated ability to influence managers and stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills with operational, technical, and executive audiences.
* A strong orientation toward standardization, continuous improvement, and end\-to\-end process optimization.
* The ability to work effectively in a demanding project environment, meet tight deadlines, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* A minimum of 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in Sales, Customer Service, business process transformation, or ERP implementation.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience engaging stakeholders, communicating business direction, and supporting change management through adoption.
* Experience participating in an ERP deployment, including design workshops, testing, operational readiness, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\), considered an asset.
* The ability to communicate in both French and English, verbally and in writing, to meet the requirements of the role and interact with various stakeholders.

**How this job stands out from the rest:*** Work from home up to 3 days per week.
* Flexible schedule.
* Comprehensive group insurance plan with employer contributions starting on your first day.
* Retirement savings program with employer contributions from day one.

  

Message from the Recruiters  

  

We can’t wait to meet you!  

  

Because we’re passionate about people, we’re eager to learn about your aspirations and see how your potential can flourish with us.  

  

Want to learn more about the opportunities that could be waiting for you? We’re looking forward to your application!  

  

About us  

  

Supported by a vast North American distribution network and more than 1,200 dedicated employees, our group stands out as a major player in the heating, air conditioning, and ventilation sectors. Recognized among the Best Managed Companies, our businesses leverage the complementarity of their expertise to drive innovation and build a sustainable future.

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Nucleus Independent Living is an innovative and learning organization, focused on providing exceptional, culturally\-sensitive care to residents in the Mississauga Halton community to enable frail seniors and adults living with physical disabilities to live their best life independently, at home. Our highly committed staff embody our ICCARE values of Innovation, Compassion, Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence in the delivery of personalized care, where every person’s experience is exceptional, every time. We are committed to creating a safe environment where you feel heard, valued for the work you do, able to grow and learn, and make a difference to every person you touch.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, provide leadership, financial expertise, and sound management principles in planning, directing, and delivering core corporate finance services, with a particular emphasis on financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), while working as part of an innovative and committed senior leadership team. The role serves as a strategic business partner to the CFO, CEO, Senior Leadership Team and Board of Directors, leading the budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and performance reporting that inform resource allocation, funding decisions and the organization’s long\-term financial sustainability. The role also oversees information technology (through the organization’s External IT Service Provider), property management, and administrative services. As a health information custodian, this role is also responsible for the management of risks and business impacts of privacy laws and policies related to the collection, use, disclosure and retention of personal health information by all staff, volunteers, and vendors of the organization.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

Key Responsibilities:

* Oversee all Financial Operations, including Payroll \& Benefits Administration in a unionized environment.
* Provide interpretation and advice to all levels of management and staff on organizational business, financial issues, organizational budgetary issues and reporting of government funded services.
* Lead the annual operating budget process ($20M\+), including setting planning assumptions, partnering with program leaders to build departmental budgets, and presenting the budget for approval by the Board of Directors, in alignment with the Ministry of Health and Ontario Health’s Multi\-Service Sector Accountability Agreement (M\-SAA).
* Develop and maintain multi\-year financial plans and rolling forecasts, including scenario and sensitivity analysis, to support strategic decision\-making and long\-term financial sustainability.
* Build and maintain financial models to evaluate new programs, service expansions, funding proposals, capital investments and other business cases, providing clear, evidence\-based recommendations to the CFO, CEO and Board.
* Analyze program\-level costs, funding and service volumes (e.g., cost per unit of service) to identify trends, efficiency opportunities and financial risks, and recommend corrective actions to program leaders.
* Develop and report key performance indicators and management dashboards that connect financial results to operational and service outcomes.
* Lead the financial analysis supporting funding applications, in\-year forecast submissions and funding reallocation requests to Ontario Health and other funders.
* Lead the preparation of financial statements, variance analysis explaining key drivers, forecasts and other monthly, quarterly and annual financial and statistical reports and analysis to internal stakeholders and external stakeholders which include the MOH, Ontario Health Central and the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA), ensuring compliance with reporting requirements and funding agreements.
* Oversee the creation and implementation of sound internal controls that ensure general ledger integrity, accuracy and compliance of financial reporting and mechanisms for appropriate budget control.
* Oversee the external audit of financial statements including the preparation of various year end working papers.
* Lead and develop a team of two (2\) Financial Analysts, building the team’s capability in financial analysis, forecasting and decision\-support reporting.
* Develop and oversee back office support initiatives to other non\-profit/registered charity organizations.
* In conjunction with the Chief Financial Officer and Senior Leadership Team, work to design, develop, and implement strategic and operational plans, ensuring they are supported by sound financial plans, analysis and resource allocation.
* Oversee the Organization’s insurance requirements ensuring adequate coverage and that risk management processes are in place to protect the organization’s assets.
* Staff support to the Finance, Resource and Audit Committee as well as participation in other Board and Operational committees as required.
* Provide oversight of the organization’s information technology through Nucleus’s External IT Service Provider, including managing the service agreement and provider performance, the IT budget and IT\-related risks, and ensuring finance and reporting systems deliver accurate, timely information for decision\-making.
* Oversee the organization's physical infrastructure, including maintenance and upkeep of the facilities, lease negotiation, office allocation, building renovations or upgrades.
* Oversee all the activities related to the development, implementation, maintenance and adherence to the organization’s privacy policies and procedures. These policies cover the collection, use, disclosure and retention of personal health information in compliance with the Personal Health Information Protection Act (“PHIPA”).

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs the responsibilities of the position according to legislative and regulatory standards set out in Provincial Acts and consistent with the policies of Nucleus Indep
